questions.question: What does Hosea 6 call the people to do?
options: Offer up many more sacrifices to win back his favor
Build new altars for themselves on every high place
Flee away to Egypt for safety from the great foe
Return to the LORD, who has torn but will heal
questions.answer: Return to the LORD, who has torn but will heal

questions.question: What does God desire more than sacrifice, according to Hosea 6?
options: Gold and silver from the nations
Steadfast love and the knowledge of God
Burnt offerings and very many sacrifices
questions.answer: Steadfast love and the knowledge of God

questions.question: Hosea 6 says God's going out is sure as the dawn, and he will come like the rain.
Come, let us _____ to the LORD; for he has torn us, that he may heal us.
I desire steadfast love and not _____, the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
